authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10158 supplies mukha “mouth/face”; in the full 10174 discussion Turner explicitly prefers mukha with expressive doubling to mukhya for retained-k(h) mouth/face forms. Following that primary preference and the preceding reviewed policy, these bare muk responses are attached to the mouth noun, not the adjective “chief”. This is a family-level assignment; expressive history versus learned/contact transmission in the individual survey languages remains open.
